paragraphs.title: The Tension Between Hannah and Peninnah

easy.explanation: Elkanah had two wives, Hannah and Peninnah.

answers: She wept and did not eat

answers: It caused her to weep and not eat
It caused her to leave for Shiloh

answers: She gave birth to a son
